# Vercel: put firewall configuration

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To update firewall configuration in Vercel, send a PUT request to the firewall configuration endpoint with SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for exact endpoint path, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for required request body schema, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for authentication method and required scopes, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for expected response shape and status codes, and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for error codes when configuration is invalid. Agents must include SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for required fields like project ID and configuration rules.

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/vercel-put-firewall --json
